integrity: Two distinct exact tests on each of 13 members: squarefree binary-quartic discriminants and Groebner Jacobian unit ideals on four charts. Executable source and output embedded.
scientific_limitations: Existence and maximal dimension are proved only over F3 for rational combinations; no complete classification of nets, no geometric smoothness of nonrational combinations, and no priority claim against unindexed literature.
title: A sharp smooth anticanonical net on the split quadric over \(\mathbf F_3\)
